name: E-star-12B-base
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-3-12b-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of google/gemma-3-12b-it on 6,311 K2-Feedback examples. Text-only: the repo ships a Gemma3ForCausalLM config with 10 shards and no vision tower, so 11.766B params against the multimodal base's 12.187B is the removed vision encoder, not a size saving on the language model. Recorded because the card prints a base row and this row in the same three tables (EN feedback, KO feedback, RAG quality). Licence cc-by-nc-4.0, repo created 2026-03-24. Card is Korean; metrics read from sections 5.1-5.3.

benchmarks.name: Feedback-Bench (EN) Pearson
benchmarks.config: Card section 5.1 table, row 'Instruct SLM | Gemma-3-12B-IT' 0.810 vs 'Ours | E-Star-12B-Base' 0.856 (x100). Korean card; 6,311 K2-Feedback examples.

benchmarks.name: RAG-Quality-Bench average
benchmarks.config: Card section 5.3 table, column 'Average': Gemma-3-12B-IT 0.745 vs E-Star-12B-Base 0.806 (x100). Six sub-metrics (LAW/FIN x CR/F/RR); the card itself notes Faithfulness loses or ties (LAW 0.730 vs 0.742, FIN 0.720 vs 0.713), so the average carries the win.
